guarantees.claim: When parameter Num equals 3, signal sel_chk (mux3_sel_e) is continuously driven by the cast mux3_sel_e'(sel_o).

uncertain_points.claim: The direct cast of sel_o to mux3_sel_e does not check for out-of-range values. If sel_o can ever carry an illegal enumeration value, sel_chk will propagate it, possibly causing incorrect mux selection downstream.
uncertain_points.cond: When sel_o holds a value not defined in mux3_sel_e
uncertain_points.risk: Illegal mux selection may lead to data corruption or bypass of security-critical path selection in the AES module.
